protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: Confirmed independently. At fix parent f635d552241c348be8a0020f531a3e278e89b6d9, View::renderFile passes caller params unchanged to renderPhpFile; renderPhpFile then executes extract($_params_, EXTR_OVERWRITE) in the same scope as local $_file_ before require $_file_. A params key _file_ therefore replaces the intended include path. ErrorHandler::renderFile contains the same collision on its fallback path. Live GHSA and CVE records describe this mechanism; GHSA withdrawn_at is null and CVE state is PUBLISHED.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: Confirmed 269ce903bdfb3a41e2a5b2cfc8e47bb898e54481. Its diff directly adds renderFileInternal($_file_, $_params_) with extract($_params_, EXTR_OVERWRITE) followed by require($_file_). Earlier e585c69fbbfa2c5d096c7661e0cb3293f4da3f21 used EXTR_PREFIX_SAME, and cf6d2699540f8148c197d0d97a1819216b451d33 used EXTR_OVERWRITE but required the object property $this->file; neither has the local-path overwrite mechanism. Later renderFile/renderPhpFile changes preserve or move the already vulnerable combination.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: Confirmed. The BIC has immediate parent 9d1b97189d44fd4d323253196f654917b0147826. That parent extracts with EXTR_OVERWRITE but requires $this->file and has no local $_file_ include target, so the advisory's parameter-name collision is absent.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: Confirmed not applicable. protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_unpatched_state: Confirmed direct fix 109878b491dbffa541032bc99fb5e26d12cd0375. It moves extraction and inclusion into a closure whose include path comes from func_get_arg(0), preventing an extracted _file_ variable from replacing it in both View and ErrorHandler. It adds regression tests that pass a secret path as _file_ and require the safe view output, and framework/CHANGELOG.md explicitly records CVE-2026-39850.
